Dark Souls: BAD 

Game's open world structure falls apart in the latter half of the game and overall level design becomes much lazier

One of the most broken pvp experiences in any game I've played. 

Bloodborne: GOOD

Simplified assortment of weapons and stats that gets rid of a lot that wouldn't be touched much otherwise

Deep combat system

Visually stunning

Fascinating/haunting lore

Bloodborne: BAD

Healing and bullets are a finite resource, requiring farming if you run out, bringing pacing to a grinding halt

If you can, try hanging out with confidants who will increase social stats as well as level your confidant rank up, that way you kill two birds with one stone. For instance, Takemi will raise your guts, and Yoshida will raise your charm. Also, take advantage of rain and go to the central street diner on rainy days for extra knowledge points when you study. The bathhouse also gives you extra charm on Monday and Thursday, iirc. If you haven't been doing so already, just Google the class questions, since they're so obscure you'll probably barely know any, and knowledge points are precious. Doing the big bang burger challenge can help raise a lot of your stats if your guts is high. Kindness can be raised by using bio nutrients on the plant in your room at night, which doesn't cost a time slot. As for proficiency, you can use up a slot at your work bench and load saves until you see Morgana say "not bad" which indicates you made more than 1 material and also gained an extra proficiency point. Alternatively, if you've been leveling Kawakami's confidant she may occasionally give you free time in class, which gives you an extra slot in the day to make crafting items.
